annotations.title: Save a draft or the final cut of a studio edit

description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] `action: "save_draft"` stores the edit as it stands as a named version; free, nothing renders. `action: "save_final"` with `quoteId` (an accepted render quote: plan the project, then quote step `render`, estimate first) stores it and renders it; once ready it becomes the final cut, one at a time, and earlier versions are kept. `action: "reopen"` with `cutId` puts a saved version back on the board; the next save is a new version.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/video-studio/projects/{id}/cuts.)
name: save_studio_cut
title: Save a draft or the final cut of a studio edit
